question: What word should be spoken at the end of the repeated accomplish command?
premises: The repeated 'accomplish' command reaches its end.
The word parama is to be spoken.
This is prescribed as part of the recitation.
inference: At the end of the pair of 'accomplish' commands, one should also say 'parama.'
plain_english: But at the end of the pair of 'accomplish' commands, one should also say 'supreme.'
